title: Structured NLU output (docs/TECHNICAL.md v3.2 section 8.3)
description: The documented conceptual schema, with additionalProperties=false so extra model-authored keys fail validation instead of passing silently. required matches TECHNICAL exactly: conceptually optional fields may be omitted, and an omitted optional field is compared as null. The intent field stays a plain string because TECHNICAL section 8.3 does not constrain it with an enum; intent names are scored against docs/TECHNICAL.md section 9.

intent.description: Greeting, ProductSearch, ProductDetails, ProductComparison, AvailabilityCheck, PriceCheck, BusinessInfo, HumanHandoff, UnsupportedMedia or OutOfScope.
